title: HOLD-LC-001 official gdt-core Rsp2 selection semantics crosswalk
question: What exact selection and boundary semantics does the pinned public gdt-core Rsp2 implementation provide before any source-owned response validity or timing likelihood is admitted?
method: Preserve the established T-054 forward, T-059/T-061 observation-first inverse, owner order and promotion firewalls; add only a source-semantic crosswalk.
Pin USRA-STI/gdt-core commit and response.py SHA-256 in a gitignored local source cache and preserve the official locator in the contract.
Read only the R-468 interval metadata and recompute strict-overlap, first/last fallback and first-index delegation without response coefficients.
Probe exact segment endpoints and a labeled overlapping-interval fixture to expose implementation/docstring differences.
Run primary, non-importing independent, hostile, integrated and Lean checks; issue no intermediate PDF.
finding: The public implementation is precisely pinned and supplies software-level selection semantics, but its nearest_drm docstring is not a center-distance rule and strict endpoint fallback differs from closed covering. This advances provenance only; it does not fill physical-owner validity, timing or uncertainty fields.
decision_reason: R-469 is the next nonredundant owner-intake step after R-468: it fixes the exact public software semantics before any response values or physical timing law could be admitted, while leaving the existing research methods unchanged.
decision_scope: T0 finite source semantics over R-468 response-segment metadata; no response coefficients, calibration rule, timing conversion, likelihood, covariance, score, prediction or physical inference
boundary: Finite software-semantic provenance only. Source-owned validity/interpolation, time standard, detector-to-geocenter conversion, uncertainty, likelihood, covariance, nuisance, complete F_reg/F_lim/F_eff/F_obs map, candidate scoring, prospective holdout and physical identity remain open.
evidence_level: T0 exact public source commit/file hash plus finite metadata-only semantic crosswalk
assumptions: The pinned commit and source-file SHA identify the exact public implementation audited here.
The R-468 primary report remains the authoritative finite segment metadata projection and its SHA is checked before use.
The semantic crosswalk can be evaluated from interval metadata alone; no response coefficient or heap array is required.
The official implementation's scipy dependency and kwargs are not a complete physical calibration-validity contract.
The established T-054 forward method, T-059 inverse method, T-061 owner order and promotion firewalls remain controlling.
missing_assumptions: Source-owned validity rule tying each response segment to event and spectral-history windows.
Pinned scipy version and source-owned interpolation domain/kwargs policy if interpolation is ever admitted.
Detector-to-geocenter propagation conversion, common time standard and timing uncertainty.
Frozen detector, energy, background and temporal windows with a joint likelihood/covariance/nuisance contract.
Complete candidate-neutral F_reg/F_lim/F_eff/F_obs map, immutable scorer and prospective holdout.
next_action: Request and hash-pin source-owned response-validity/interpolation, common time-standard, detector-to-geocenter and timing-uncertainty rules; preserve NONE_SELECTED and do not score.
stop_or_redesign: If the source commit or parent metadata hash drifts, refresh the versioned contract rather than mutating this record.
If the owner cannot supply validity/interpolation and uncertainty fields, retain this finite crosswalk and park event-free scoring.
If a later owner changes the response contract, issue a new versioned contract; do not alter the established methods.
